newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dao Heng arm signs HK$18 bln CD programme.
newsitem.headline: Dao Heng arm signs HK$18 bln CD programme.

text.p: Dao Heng Bank Ltd, a unit of Dao Heng Bank Group Ltd, signed an HK$18 billion certificate of deposit programme with 11 financial institutions on Thursday, the bank said.

The programme provides for both Hong Kong dollar and U.S. dollar issues in the form of floating-rate, fixed-rate and discounted certificates of deposit. Put and call options can be incorporated under the terms of the individual issues.

The dealer group comprises Banque Nationale de Paris's Hongkong branch, DKB Asia, HSBC Markets, Jardine Fleming Bank, LTCB Asia, Schroders Asia, Societe Generale Asia, Tokyo-Mitsubishi International (HK), Union Bank of Switzerland's Hongkong branch, Westdeutsche Landesbank and Westpac Banking Corp's Hongkong branch.
HSBC Markets is the arranger for the programme and the Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp is acting as issuing, reference and paying agent.
Dao Heng Bank is rated A3 by Moody's Investors Service and BBB-plus by Standard & Poor's.
Dao Heng Bank Group Ltd is a subsidiary of Hongkong-listed Guoco Group Ltd 0053.HK
